data.camera: medium shot, eating roasted meat at tavern table
data.description: 【艾莉丝 · 边境旅店】边境小镇的旅店里，艾莉丝把剑靠在桌边，大口啃着热腾腾的烤肉，冒险者外套搭在椅背上，红发随意披散——「旅店的饭就该这样实在，比府邸的礼仪餐强多了。」
data.promptProse: Eris rests at the frontier inn table with a roast-meat feast, laughing heartily between bites in her practical Dead End jacket, trousers and boots. Sword and sheath remain secured at the belt. The medium view includes the meal and wooden mugs, rough timber walls receding beyond the bench. Warm oil-lamp light catches the meat's browned surface and her red hair, leaving soft mug shadows and deeper gaps between the wall planks.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 边境旅店
